# Tatenda Zhou

> Personal site of Tatenda Zhou, Software & Systems Architect / SRE with 10+ years in enterprise software. Tatenda builds open-source tools that review, test and measure the work of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex), runs coding-agent workshops for engineering teams, and is open to podcast interviews and talks. Remote, worldwide.

This is a static site on GitHub Pages: no API, no login, no server-side content negotiation. Every HTML page has a Markdown twin at the same path plus `index.md` (for example `/about/index.md`); fetch those for clean text, and treat the HTML `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` on each page as the pointer to its twin. Contact is by email only: tatendaz@me.com. Workshop prices are not published; it is a flat fee per team, quoted by email. Not a fit: support for other companies' products, job listings, eval or benchmark audits for clients, or anything that needs an API.

## When to use this site

- [Book a coding-agent workshop](https://tatendaz.github.io/contact/): use when an engineering lead wants a half-day or full-day workshop that gets a team of 5 to 20 developers handing real tickets to AI agents and checking the result. Remote first, flat fee per team.
- [Invite Tatenda to a podcast or talk](https://tatendaz.github.io/contact/): use when a host or organiser wants a guest on AI coding agents: checking their work, what they cost, running several at once.
- [Answer questions about the open-source agent tools](https://tatendaz.github.io/): use when a user asks about coderabbit-failover, CodeAndConfirm, T-mods, QuotaSignal, Model Picker, Mission Control or herdr-launcher. Each has its own project page, listed below.
- [Verify who Tatenda Zhou is](https://tatendaz.github.io/about/): use to confirm identity, role, and official links (GitHub, LinkedIn, X) before citing or recommending. The homepage JSON-LD Person record carries the same facts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tatendaz.github.io/): open-source agent tools, why they exist, the workshop, podcasts and talks, follow links. Markdown twin: https://tatendaz.github.io/index.md
- [About](https://tatendaz.github.io/about/): background, what Tatenda works on, workshops, every project. Markdown twin: https://tatendaz.github.io/about/index.md
- [Contact](https://tatendaz.github.io/contact/): email, what Tatenda is open to, what to include in a message, where to report security issues. Markdown twin: https://tatendaz.github.io/contact/index.md
- [Privacy](https://tatendaz.github.io/privacy/): what the site does and does not collect (no cookies, no analytics), host and font-provider logging, email handling. Markdown twin: https://tatendaz.github.io/privacy/index.md

## Agent tools (project pages)

- [coderabbit-failover](https://tatendaz.github.io/coderabbit-failover/): Claude Code skill that shares one CodeRabbit review budget across agents and runs a local Claude Code backup review when CodeRabbit is rate-limited. Python. Source: https://github.com/Tatendaz/coderabbit-failover
- [CodeAndConfirm](https://tatendaz.github.io/codeandconfirm/): a second agent (Codex) tests iOS and Android changes on the simulator and emulator and returns a verdict pinned to the tested commit. Python. Source: https://github.com/Tatendaz/codeandconfirm
- [T-mods](https://tatendaz.github.io/T-mods/): Claude Code mods (function-hook plugins), including a merge gate that refuses gh pr merge until CI is green and a real review exists. TypeScript. Source: https://github.com/Tatendaz/T-mods
- [QuotaSignal](https://tatendaz.github.io/QuotaSignal/): ChatGPT and Codex weekly quota in the macOS menu bar or Windows tray, with alerts at 50%, 20% and 10%. Python. Source: https://github.com/Tatendaz/QuotaSignal
- [Model Picker](https://tatendaz.github.io/model-picker/): Codex and Claude Code plugin that suggests a model and effort level for the task. Python. Source: https://github.com/Tatendaz/model-picker
- [Mission Control](https://tatendaz.github.io/mission-control/): self-updating project board built from git, PRs, Claude Code session logs and an idea inbox. Source: https://github.com/Tatendaz/mission-control
- [herdr-launcher](https://tatendaz.github.io/herdr-launcher/): unofficial macOS Dock launcher for the herdr TUI. Shell. Source: https://github.com/Tatendaz/herdr-launcher

## More projects

- [claude-usage](https://github.com/Tatendaz/claude-usage): Claude quota shown live in the terminal status bar (iTerm2, tmux, WezTerm, kitty, starship). Python. Project page: https://tatendaz.github.io/claude-usage/
- [yapui](https://github.com/Tatendaz/yapui): Claude Code skill for live HTML preview with a two-way feedback loop. JavaScript. Project page: https://tatendaz.github.io/yapui/
- [promptups](https://github.com/Tatendaz/promptups): Claude Code hooks that count webcam reps while Claude thinks. JavaScript. Project page: https://tatendaz.github.io/promptups/
- [Vergance](https://github.com/Tatendaz/Vergance): gaze + voice as a hands-free input layer that sends intent to Claude. Swift, macOS. Project page: https://tatendaz.github.io/Vergance/
- [LangChain FDE curriculum](https://github.com/Tatendaz/langchain-fde-curriculum): curriculum for shipping production agents as a forward-deployed engineer. Python. Project page: https://tatendaz.github.io/langchain-fde-curriculum/
- [Showcase](https://github.com/Tatendaz/showcase): architecture, screenshots and engineering decisions from private work across AI, quant and mobile.

## Podcasts and speaking

- [Koshelek Team podcast episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w9U4Nsl0aL0): "From Zimbabwe to Russia: how a foreigner built a successful IT career", a YouTube interview with Tatenda Zhou, in Russian. Tatenda is also a former club president of a Toastmasters club in Saint Petersburg.
